data.name: Urjas
data.gender_notes: Urjas is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Urjas is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'urj' which means energy or vitality. It is a powerful name that signifies the strength and power within an individual. It is an evocative name that inspires confidence and determination. The name Urjas carries the meaning “Vitality, Energy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Urjas usually hope their child will grow to embody vitality, energy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Urjas is a name that symbolizes the divine energy that resides within every individual. It is a name that reminds us of our inner strength and the power that we possess to overcome any challenges that come our way.
data.etymology: Urjas belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Vitality, Energy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Urjas total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Urjas holds immense significance in Hindu culture as it embodies the essence of strength, virility, and vitality. It is believed that the name bestows upon the bearer immense energy and power, making them a force to be reckoned with. In essence, Urjas represents the indomitable spirit that is inherent in all of us and is often associated with warriors and heroes.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Urjas holds deep meaning as it is believed to represent the divine energy that resides within each of us. It is a reminder of our inherent power and strength, and the potential for greatness that lies within us. The name Urjas serves as a reminder to tap into our inner resources and harness the power within us to live our lives to the fullest. It is a powerful and inspiring name that can serve as a source of strength and motivation in times of need.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Urjas: Radiance of inner energy and vitality. A name that symbolizes the awakened and unyielding spirit, invoking strength, vitality, and the power to overcome challenges.

vedic_reference.note: The name Urjas is derived from the Sanskrit root 'Ruj' which means 'to flow'. In Hinduism, the concept of Urja or vitality is associated with the divine energies that flow through the universe and sustain all life. The name is also associated with the god Rudra, who is known as the god of energy and vitality.
